outline.chapter_title: I. Case Background and Procedural Posture
outline.description: Establishes the factual narrative of the crime, the critical evidence, and the procedural history that led to the appellate review.
subtopics: Overview of the 2020 incident and the parties involved
Police investigation and evidence collection
Trial proceedings and jury verdict
Sentencing under the Armed Career Criminal Act (ACCA) and advisory guidelines
Appeal filing and the specific contentions raised by Cutbank

outline.chapter_title: II. Evidentiary and Procedural Issues Presented by the Defendant
outline.description: Analyzes each evidentiary challenge the defendant raises, explains the trial court’s rulings, and applies relevant case law to show why the appellate court found no reversible error.
subtopics: A. Rule 404(b) and intrinsic evidence of prior possession
B. Confrontation Clause and jury instructions regarding hearsay
C. Admission of prior instances of weapon possession
D. Striking of additional character statements and prejudice analysis
E. Cross‑examination of government witnesses and authentication requirements
F. Harmless error doctrine and cumulative effect of evidentiary rulings

outline.chapter_title: III. Sentencing Law and the Application of USSG § 2K2.1(b)(6)(B)
outline.description: Explores the statutory framework governing ACCA sentencing enhancements, the appropriate use of the US Sentencing Guidelines, and the Supreme Court and lower‑court guidance on calculating offense levels.
subtopics: A. Overview of ACCA enhancements and the role of § 2K2.1(b)(6)(B)
B. Calculation of the offense level and criminal history category
C. Application of the 4‑level “facilitated possession” enhancement
D. Supreme Court guidance on the core principle of § 3553(a) and its application to guideline‑based sentencing
E. Review of the district court’s range calculation and compliance with § 3553(a) factors

outline.chapter_title: IV. The Court’s Reasoning and Final Holding
outline.description: Summarizes how the appellate court integrated the evidentiary findings and sentencing analysis to arrive at its decision to affirm both the conviction and sentence.
subtopics: A. Integration of factual and evidentiary findings
B. Justification for affirming the appellate court’s discretion in sentencing within the guideline range
C. Clarification of the appellate standard for reviewing sentencing decisions
D. Final conclusion and legal precedent cited
